biggest_catch: The friend has to register BEFORE opening their account using your referral email - and a business referral pays the friend $150 while you still only get $50.
catches: The referred person must register for the program PRIOR to opening the checking account (using the referral email or in a branch) - referrals can't be applied retroactively.
Personal checking: friend must open the account within 90 days of the referral, then within 60 days complete 10+ Visa debit purchases, one $300+ ACH direct deposit, and enroll in Online Statements.
Business checking: friend must open within 90 days with $500+ deposited on day one, then make at least one Visa Business Debit Card purchase and enroll in Online Statements within 60 days.
Max $500 in referral rewards per calendar year; only the first referrer (per Regions' records) gets the reward if the same person is referred twice.

Referrer must be a Regions checking customer with a positive balance; employees and anyone without a valid US TIN are excluded; referred person must not have had a Regions deposit account in the last 12 months.

steps: Be a Regions Bank checking customer (18+) with a positive balance and log in to Offer Tracker with your online banking credentials.
Click 'Send a Referral' and provide the friend's contact info and valid email address; Regions sends them the referral email on your behalf.
Your friend registers for the program PRIOR to opening a checking account (using the referral email or in a branch) and opens a new Regions personal or business checking account within 90 days.

The friend completes within 60 days of opening: 10+ Visa debit purchases (personal) or 1+ business debit purchase, a $300+ ACH direct deposit (personal), and Online Statements enrollment; business accounts need a $500+ deposit on day one.
You receive $50 deposited to your Regions checking account within 60 days of all requirements being completed (up to $500 per calendar year).
timing: Reward deposited to referrer's Regions checking within 60 days of all requirements being completed.
